processing.exclude: All-Star, playoffs, preseason, neutral-site games, invalid or prematurely final results
processing.limitations: Latest revised historical files are used; this is not an archived point-in-time data feed. Start times are used with a conservative 48-hour lag because final-publication times are unavailable. No injuries, lineups, roster changes or odds features.

featureDefinitions: Home minus away average point margin in up to 20 prior regular-season games
Home minus away win fraction in those same games
